name: Leader Rocco
marketText: The arena is caught in a sandstorm. Ground moves hit 1.5× harder, and everyone else takes a little damage each turn.
lines: “Welcome to the Fizzwell arena. Here we battle in a sandstorm.”
win: “Well fought. The Ground Badge is yours.”
lose: “The ground always wins. Come back stronger.”
hint: Leader Rocco’s Ground team is level 12–15, and the battle opens in a sandstorm. Water and Grass moves hit Ground hard.
